nodes.label: Shell Smoke Test Wallpaper (wallpaper.svg)
nodes.rationale: 1200x850 synthetic wallpaper: horizontal blue (#1f439c) to purple (#782766) gradient, semi-transparent light-blue vertical stripes (40px every 80px), and a central orange (#ffb35c) circle. Deterministic, high-contrast fixture for the GNOME Shell smoke test, likely so wallpaper-dependent rendering (e.g. top bar/dock coloring or transparency) produces distinguishable, repeatable results.
